content:
watchOS 27 is the latest major software update for Apple Watch, and it includes three new apps for your smartwatch to use.

#1: Siri

Siri has undergone a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, and part of that is a brand-new Siri app.

The Siri app is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

You can still summon Siri with the Digital Crown in watchOS 27, but this app is another way you can start a conversation. More importantly, you can browse past conversation history right inside the app.

Siri AI is much more conversational than the old assistant, and it saves your query history across all your devices. So the Siri app on watchOS 27 shows not only your conversations from Apple Watch, but also those from iPhone, Mac, and other devices.

#2: Find My

Alongside the new features coming to the Find My app in iOS 27, Apple has also reimagined the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple has brought all of the find-my functionality together in a brand-new, unified 'Find My' app.

Find My on Apple Watch offers all the functionality of the previous three apps, but in a more streamlined experience so you can easily locate any item or person on a map-centric interface.

You can switch between different search categories using the menu in the top-left corner, but beyond that the experience is consistent.

#3: Readiness

If you have an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 also adds a third app: Readiness.

Here's how the App Store describes the Readiness app's features:

Readfulness app analyses your recent activity, vitals, and sleep data to help you understand how ready you are to take on a new day. Features include: get a score and a clear status classification, including Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. See explanations of the contributing factors and tap through to the relevant apps. New complications and Smart Stack widgets let you see the info at a glance. View more detailed information in the Fitness app on iPhone.

In short, Readiness gives you a quick overview of your overall vitals so you can see how well-rested and prepared your body is on any given day.

What do you think of the new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
